for dir in /data/*/; do
  [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
  echo ">>> Pruning $dir"
  RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$dir" restic forget \
    --keep-hourly 24 \
    --keep-daily 5 \
    --keep-weekly 4 \
    --keep-monthly 3 \
    --prune \
    --verbose
done

cat << 'EOF' > /var/www/html/.htaccess
# BEGIN WordPress
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/server-status
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>
# END WordPress
EOF
chown www-data:www-data /var/www/html/.htaccess

apk add --no-cache curl jq
npm install -g @bitwarden/cli@2026.7.0
export BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR=/.config
rm -rf /.config/* ~/.config/* 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Configuring BW server to: $BW_HOST"
bw config server "$BW_HOST"
bw status | jq .environmentUrl
bw login --apikey "$BW_CLIENTID" "$BW_CLIENTSECRET"
export BW_SESSION=$(bw unlock --passwordenv BW_PASSWORD --raw)
exec bw serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 8088
